name: Virgillian
description: Virgillians were the residents of the Virgillia system in the Koradin sector. Virgillian society had a nobility, which included the family of Rannd Delckis. The Duros navigator Monnda Tebbo, a Rebel Alliance member who was sent to Virgillia for several weeks, was one of the few non-Humans to fight in the Virgillian Civil War and was considered to be an honorary Virgillian citizen.
